rejected_commits.reason: Linked, but it is the incomplete fix for CVE-2014-1402 (GHSA-8r7q-cvjq-x353); this advisory exists because that fix was incomplete. It passes a release check against OSV's (wrong) range.

truth_evidence: NVD: 'FileSystemBytecodeCache in Jinja2 2.7.2 and earlier does not properly create temporary directories ... because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2014-1402.' OSV records the fixed version as 2.7.2, which is wrong: 2.7.2 is affected.
Fix commit 964c61ce 'Fix CVE-2014-0012' (2014-02-09), in tag 2.7.3 and not in 2.7.2. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/964c61ce79f6748ff8c583e2eb12ec54082bf188

_get_default_cache_dir (as it exists in 2.7.2): fixes the 'os.name == "n"' typo, uses stat.S_IRWXU, and after mkdir checks that the directory is owned by the current uid, is a directory, and is mode 0700.
In 2.7.1 and earlier the equivalent code lives in FileSystemBytecodeCache.__init__ (see the sibling advisory); the pre-fix name depends on which release is treated as pre-fix.
notes: Tricky case: a release check driven by OSV's range (fixed = 2.7.2) rejects the real fix and accepts the linked, incomplete one. The pipeline cannot get this one right from OSV data alone; an override is the expected route.
PRs #292 and #296 that the advisory links are unrelated 2010-era tickets in the old Jinja tracker, not GitHub pull requests.
